author: Zintenka
body:
I noticed that the docs were talking about region selection for spawns.

Is it like this?

teams:   
   cyan:   
       spawn:  
       type: cuboid     
       min: 126,70,1580     
       max: 106,80,1616       
       title: Cyanaras   
       max: 50

title: YML Question

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
No, use spawns: then - <coordinate>

teams:
   cyan:
      spawns:
      - 126,70,1580,90,0
      - 106,80,1616,90,0
      title: Cyanaras
      max: 50

EDIT: I think I'm wrong, you might use points or something. But anywho...
